## Student outreach brief — official sources

- **Lewis & Clark College** — [Admissions](https://college.lclark.edu/offices/admissions/) | **Contact:** admissions@lclark.edu; 503-768-7040. **Deadlines:** Early Decision I and Early Action, November 1; Early Decision II and Regular Decision, January 15; transfer is rolling, with credentials recommended by April 1. **Useful program/message hook:** 29 majors, 38 minors, preprofessional programs, and the Career Accelerator; early-decision applicants are promised a dedicated career consultant and a paid internship by the end of junior year.

- **Hunter College, Silberman School of Social Work** — [Admissions](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/) | **Contact:** grad.socworkadvisor@hunter.cuny.edu; admissions visits: 212-396-7888. **Deadline example:** the one-year residency DOHMH Mental Health Scholarship Program lists a March 1 application deadline and March 15 supporting-documentation deadline; its letter of intent is listed as TBA in early January. **Program examples:** post-master’s, MSW, and PhD in Social Welfare; the MSW options include Clinical Practice, Community Organization, and Organizational Management.

- **Indiana University Kokomo** — [Contact Admissions](https://kokomo.iu.edu/admissions/staff/index.html) · [Apply](https://kokomo.iu.edu/admissions/apply-now/index.html) | **Contact:** iuk.admissions@iu.edu; 765-455-9217. **Deadline/process:** the official page does not state a fixed general application deadline; it says applications are reviewed daily and decisions follow receipt of all required information. **Program examples/hooks:** 60+ degrees and programs; outreach-ready segments include high-school, transfer, adult/returning, international, and guest students. Named contacts include transfer counselor Kayla Howard (765-455-9212; kayrhowa@iu.edu) and ICC Program Manager Jeremy Edom (765-455-9242; jedom@iu.edu).

- **UCSF, Northern California glioblastoma trials** — [UCSF Glioblastoma Studies](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/glioblastoma) | The live UCSF listing reports **38 in progress and 16 open to eligible people** (page says last updated September 11, 2026). Examples accepting eligible patients in **San Francisco** include the E-SYNC CAR-T study for EGFRvIII-positive glioblastoma (18+), DOC1021 dendritic-cell immunotherapy for newly diagnosed adult GBM (18+), and the MOAB trial of neoadjuvant atezolizumab for recurrent GBM with low mutational burden (18+). The listing also includes trials at San Francisco and other locations, plus an Oakland listing. Eligibility and recruiting status are study-specific—use the UCSF page’s individual study records before outreach or referral.

- **Oral Roberts University (ORU) student activities** — [Life at ORU](https://oru.edu/life-at-oru/index.php) | **Contact:** 918-495-6161. **Program/activity examples:** 40+ student-run clubs and organizations; Student Association, Chaplain Leadership Program, Resident Advisor roles, Missions & Outreach, intramurals, twice-weekly Chapel, prayer groups, outreach projects, and mission trips. The page states there are 30+ mission trips per year—useful for a leadership/service-oriented student message.

- **EDF Energy / EDF UK graduate jobs** — [Graduate careers](https://careers.edfenergy.com/graduate-careers) | **Contacts:** graduate/early-career queries: YourFuture@edfenergy.com; careers-fair outreach: EDFoutreach@edf-energy.com. **Deadline rule:** each early-career role has its own listed closing date; EDF may close a role early when application numbers are reached and does not accept late applications. **Current programme examples:** Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering (Durham, Edinburgh, London), Fault Studies Engineering, I&C Engineering at Hinkley Point C, Supply Chain (Suffolk/Bristol), and Finance (stated as opening for applications in early 2027). Their process is online application, behavioural assessment, video interview, then assessment centre or face-to-face interview.

I left the official pages above open in the browser for you, including separate IU Kokomo contact and application pages. Trial openings and job vacancies are especially time-sensitive, so verify status immediately before sending a referral or outreach message.
